segments.he: וּלְהַגָּשָׁה — דְּאִיתַּקַּשׁ לִתְנוּפָה, דִּכְתִיב: ״וְלָקַח הַכֹּהֵן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה אֵת מִנְחַת הַקְּנָאוֹת וְהֵנִיף... וְהִקְרִיב״. וְלִמְלִיקָה וְלִקְמִיצָה וּלְהַקְטָרָה וּלְהַזָּיָה, דִּכְתִיב: ״בַּיּוֹם צַוּוֹתוֹ אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל״.
segments.en: «And» with regard «to bringing» the meal-offerings «near» the altar, «it is likened to waving, as it is written: “And the priest shall take the meal-offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, and shall wave» the offering before the Lord, «and sacrifice» it upon the altar” (Numbers 5:25). The words “sacrifice it” are referring to bringing the offering near the altar. «And for scooping out a fistful» of flour, «and for pinching» the necks of the bird-offerings, «and for burning» the fistful of flour on the altar, «and for sprinkling» the blood, these are derived «as it is written:» “This is the law of the burnt-offering, of the meal-offering, and of the sin-offering, and of the guilt-offering, and of the consecration-offering, and of the sacrifice of the peace-offering; which the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai on «the day that he commanded the children of Israel» to present their offerings” (Leviticus 7:37–38).

segments.he: וּלְהַשְׁקָיַית סוֹטָה — אָתְיָא ״תּוֹרָה״ ״תּוֹרָה״. כְּתִיב הָכָא: ״וְעָשָׂה לָהּ הַכֹּהֵן אֵת כׇּל הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת״, וּכְתִיב הָתָם: ״עַל פִּי הַתּוֹרָה אֲשֶׁר יוֹרוּךָ וְעַל הַמִּשְׁפָּט״.
segments.en: «And» with regard «to giving the sota to drink» from the bitter waters, this «is derived» from a verbal analogy between one instance of the word «“Torah”» and another instance of the word «“Torah.” It is written here» with respect to a sota: «“And the priest shall execute upon her all this Torah”» (Numbers 5:30), «and it is written there» with regard to judgment: «“According to the Torah, which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment,» which they shall tell you” (Deuteronomy 17:11).

segments.he: מָה מִשְׁפָּט בַּיּוֹם — אַף כָּאן בַּיּוֹם.
segments.en: «Just as judgment» may be done only «by day, so too here,» the sota is given the bitter waters to drink only «by day.»
